summary: 63-year-old woman, 2 years after a midline laparotomy for perforated diverticulitis, with a 7 cm-wide reducible midline incisional hernia, BMI 34, smoker, HbA1c 64. EHS 2023: CT for planning, pre-habilitation (smoking, weight, glycaemic control), mesh repair (retromuscular).

inputs.chiefComplaint: Bulge in the scar on my tummy
inputs.hpi: Midline laparotomy 2 years ago (Hartmann's, later reversed). Bulge along the scar for 18 months, getting bigger, uncomfortable by evening, interferes with gardening. Always goes back when lying down. No vomiting, bowels normal.

exam.abdomen: Healed midline scar. Reducible incisional hernia along the upper two-thirds of the scar, defect width about 7 cm, cough impulse, skin healthy.

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Midline incisional hernia, W2 (7 cm), reducible
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Midline incisional hernia W2 (7 cm), reducible, symptomatic. CT abdominal wall for planning; pre-habilitation (stop smoking, weight loss, HbA1c optimisation) before elective retromuscular mesh repair.
